prompt: Create a high-fidelity north-star desktop web application UI comp for ITERUM, a professional graphic designer’s campaign-direction workspace. Landscape 16:10 straight-on product interface screenshot, no device frame, no people, not a landing page. The app has three zones but the center dominates: a compact campaign brief at left, a huge near-white interactive specimen/canvas in the center, and a narrow live comparison plus review rail at right. Visual world: VARIABLE TYPE SPECIMEN from a contemporary type foundry. Near-white paper, ink black, one cobalt foundry accent, flat surfaces, generous negative space, a strict baseline grid; enormous display typography contrasted with tiny monospace labels and live axis readouts. Real content: ITERUM; campaign STATIC BLOOM; “The air remembers.”; notes ozone, crushed iris, mineral rain, warm concrete, skin. Center board must include large editable headline typography, but also equally credible image references: wet concrete under sodium light, crushed flower in clear resin, asymmetric typographic poster, a palette strip, and material swatches. Three references marked LOCKED. Right rail includes tabs REVIEW TRAY and AGENT ACTIVITY, with 3 sourced proposals, rights labels, rationale, Reject and cobalt Approve, plus a type pairing comparison using freely embeddable fonts. Make the focal interaction a territory axis control that shifts the whole board between MINERAL / FLORAL / ELECTRIC while images, typography, and palette comparison update coherently; also show one proposed reference awaiting human approval. No generic SaaS cards, no bento dashboard, no chatbot, no gradients, no fake metrics, no giant alphabet poster detached from the workflow. It must clearly remain a broad visual-direction tool, not merely a font app. Highly refined foundry typography, accessible professional density, production-grade UI.
